_comment: TREND filter calibration (EMA regime gate on the entry side). Forces UseTrend=1 and sweeps the fast/slow EMA pair; SlowEMA also acts as the price floor and the EMAX bearish-cross exit slow line. Run only if the screen kept UseTrend ON. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker ASTR -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/astr/reversion_cal_trend.json -out ./reports/ASTR_trend -months 31 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
